name: physics-sandbox-matterjs
description: Matter Playground - interactive Matter.js sandbox with live-tunable gravity/restitution/friction/time-scale, KE readouts, and versioned scene save/load. TypeScript, Vitest, CI

paragraphs: Matter Playground is a live, inspectable physics sandbox — the honest dashboard version of the earliest sketch in an Angry-Birds course series, which was really just Matter.js bodies stacked under gravity. Click the walled canvas to spawn boxes, circles, or pentagons at any size, drag them around, and tune the world while it runs: gravity, restitution, friction, air resistance, and time scale all apply instantly to every body, with each parameter clamped to a validated range. A readout panel reports body count, average speed, and total kinetic energy computed as ½mv² plus ½Iω². Scenes…
